text_block_list.text:
After I finish up training with Hishi
Amazon...

Whew, I worked up quite a sweat today!
Gotta
make sure tomorrow is just as
good... Hm?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hm... Something feels off. I guess it
won't work if I
just try to do my final
sprint all willy-nilly...
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Carrot Ranger did say that a signature
move is all
about good timing...
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, but what am I doing wrong? I'm
gonna need
some special training to
figure this out!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Looks like Biko is struggling to time her
final
sprint properly.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hey, would you mind if I do a little
partner
running with her, Teach?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The best way to perfect the timing of
your final
sprint is by pacing yourself
with someone!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Sure, go give her a hand.
Let's see if she can figure it out herself first.

text_block_list.text:
All right! It's not in me to abandon a
hardworking
student in need!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're practicing your final sprint,
right? If
you want, we can have a little
partner run.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thanks a bunch, Hishiama! Running
on my
own wasn't getting me anywhere.
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I've got your back! I'll help
you out
as much as you need me to.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You might be on to something. I guess
it's better
to find your own way than
havin' someone give
you all the answers.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Solving things on your own makes for a
good
confidence boost.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I think I'll go back to the dorm and whip
up a li'l
treat for her.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I wanna show my
support!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон and Бико Пегасус train
until the sun
begins to set.
